answer: In an agent economy, sybil resistance can come from requiring each identity to cultivate a verifiable orchard of ongoing contributions whose collective pulse must stay coherent with past actions. Peers sample the orchard and reject forks that break the rhythm. An attacker forging many identities must therefore compose and sustain a unique, consistent sonnet of behavior for every fake agent, paying in both compute for continuous generation and the risk that any mismatch collapses the whole set.
